title_en: Honesty Scholarship (1st Round, 2027): Call for Applications
summary: Current third-year students of the College of Engineering who are expected to enter their fourth year in the 2027 academic year may apply for the 2027 1st-round Honesty Scholarship (정직장학금), which awards one student USD 10,000 per year. Applicants must email their documents (self-introduction, recommendation letter, transcript and any activity evidence) to the Department of Nuclear Engineering office by Thursday, 3 December 2026. The office's contact address is in the original notice.
applies_to: Optional (for those who wish to apply): current third-year students of this university's College of Engineering who are expected to advance to the fourth year in the 2027 academic year. Students should have contributed to building a sound academic community and show exemplary leadership, locally and nationally, through consideration for others and positive influence. Only one student from the College of Engineering will be selected.

dates.what: Deadline to email application documents to the Department of Nuclear Engineering office
Selection of the scholar (during the student's third-year second semester)
Scholarship allocated and paid (as a Development Foundation designated scholarship) to the selected student

conditions: Only one student from the College of Engineering will be selected.
Selection is made from students recommended by their department, after consultation with the selection advisers and review by the College of Engineering Scholarship Committee.
The award is USD 10,000 per person per year; the 2027 amount in won is KRW 13,296,090, and the won amount changes every year according to the exchange rate applied when the fund is transferred.
The self-introduction must include your personal values formed over your life so far and your resolution for the future.
The recommendation letter may be from a dean, your academic advisor, or an acquaintance.
Evidence of activities during university (volunteering, student council and other group activities, awards and commendations) is submitted additionally only if you have it.
The selected student is invited to the scholarship award ceremony planned for the end of February each year and must attend.

In the first year one student each is selected from the College of Engineering and the College of Social Sciences; from the following year one student is selected in alternate years (order: College of Engineering, then College of Social Sciences).

translation:
2027 1st-Round Honesty Scholarship: Selection of Scholars

The selection of scholars for the 2027 1st-round Honesty Scholarship (정직장학금) will be conducted as follows. Students who wish to apply should submit their documents by email by Thursday, 3 December 2026 (2026.12.3(목)).

1. Fund overview
- Donors: donors of the Mijoo Foundation (미주재단) (donations 2023–2025 and 2025; individual names are given in the original notice)
- Purpose: to discover and support talented students who practise sound leadership based on honest character and a sense of social responsibility, and who contribute to the academic community through consideration for others and positive influence.

2. Eligibility and criteria
- Current third-year students of this university's College of Engineering who are expected to advance to the fourth year in the 2027 academic year
- Students who have contributed to building a sound academic community
- Students with leadership that serves as a model locally and nationally through consideration for others and positive influence

3. Selection plan and scholarship payment
- Number selected: 1 student from the College of Engineering
- Amount: USD 10,000 per person per year
  ※ The 2027 amount is KRW 13,296,090 per person (the won amount changes every year according to the exchange rate applied when the fund is transferred).
- Selection method: students recommended by their department are reviewed with advice from the selection advisers, examined by the College of Engineering Scholarship Committee, and one student is finally selected.
- Payment plan: selected in the second semester of the third year; allocated and paid as a Development Foundation designated scholarship (발전재단 특지장학금) in the first semester of the fourth year.
  ※ In the first year, one student each is selected from the College of Engineering and the College of Social Sciences; from the following year, one student is selected in alternate years (order: College of Engineering → College of Social Sciences).
  ※ The selected student will be invited to the scholarship award ceremony planned for the end of February each year, and attendance is mandatory.
- Documents to submit
  · Self-introduction (자기소개서) (must include the personal values you have formed over your life so far and your resolution for the future)
  · Recommendation letter (추천서) (from a dean, your academic advisor, or an acquaintance)
  · Academic transcript (성적증명서)
  · Additional submission: evidence of activities during university, if any (volunteering, student council and other group activities, awards and commendations, etc.)
- Submit to: Department of Nuclear Engineering office (contact name and email address are in the original notice)

Attachments (2) (their contents were not read):
1. 제1회 정직장학금 운영(안).docx (Operating plan for the 1st Honesty Scholarship) (21 KB)
2. 정직장학 자기소개서 및 추천서.hwpx (Honesty Scholarship self-introduction and recommendation letter forms) (27 KB)
